title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Practice the real moments
hook: Have you practiced a tie game in the last inning?
intro: In the game, the team panics late.
They have never practiced that moment.
statement: Kids handle pressure better when it feels familiar.
q1: Do you set up game situations in practice —
q2: or focus on skills and let games teach the rest?
q3: Which game moments catch your team off guard?
t1: Both can work. But players stay calm
t2: when they have been there before.
cta: Coaches — do you practice game moments?
ctaLines: Runner on third, one out. Bases loaded. Last inning.
ctaPrompt: Share your practice habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Have you practiced a tie game in the last inning?
In the game, the team panics late. They have never practiced that moment.
Kids handle pressure better when it feels familiar.
Practice game situations or focus on skills. Every team is different.
Do you practice game moments? Share your habit in the comments.
